  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  Instructions to Candidates: Answer ALL questions Missing data may be suitably assumed  
  1)           How user accounts can be created and managed by useradd, usermod and userdel  
  commands?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Write a shell script to reverse a number using while control structure.  
  (3)  
  
  C)      Explain the advantages of Linux operating system.  
  (2)  
  
  2)           Write the sequence of shell commands to do the following in a sequence.  
  
  i)Create a directory by name newdir  
  A)  
  ii) Change the working directory to newdir  
  
  iii) Create 3 empty files by name file1, file2 and file3                                (5)  
  
  iv) copy file1 to file2 and file3  
  
  v) Delete file1  
  
  
  B)      Write the appropriate Vi editor commands to do the following tasks.  
  
  i)Exit editor without making changes.  
  
  ii) move the cursor one word forward                                                    (3)  
  
  iii) Scroll the editor one screen down  
  
  
  C)      Write the purpose of following Linux commands.  
  
  i)echo

  3)        Write the significance of each of the following options used by grep command.  
  
  i)-e ii) -i iii) -v iv) -n v)-c                                                                 (5)  
  A)  
  B)   Write suitable sequence of git commands to  
  
  i)To create a directory mywork and make it as a repository.  
  
  ii) Now create a text file data.txt and add content to it and add to repository                 (3)  
  
  iii) Modify data.txt by adding some content to it and commit the changes.  
  
  
  C)   Differentiate between absolute and relative method for changing permission with  
  suitable example                                                                                (2)  
  
  4)        Suppose you have been given a large directory containing thousands of files of various  
  types. Your task is to write a script that will find all files with the extension ".txt", count  
  the number of lines in each file, and output the total number of lines across all files.        (5)  
  A)   Write a script to accomplish this task.  
  
  
  B)   Write the commands for the following tasks  
  
  i. To view all currently running processes on a Linux system?  
  ii. To send a signal to a running process in order to terminate it?                         (3)  
  iii. To start a process in the background, allowing the terminal to be used for other  
  commands?  
  
  
  C)   Describe Linux file system hierarchy.  
  (2)  
  
  5)        Write an AWK program for the following:  
  
  i. To calculate the average of the numbers in the first column of a file, but only for  
  A)           the lines that contain a word “pattern” in the second column. Use a loop to iterate  
  over the lines of the file.                                                         (5)  
  ii. To print the lines of a file in reverse order using a loop to read the lines into an  
  array and then iterating over the array in reverse order.  
  
  
  B)   Write SED editor commands for the following:  
  
  i.To replace all occurrences of a word “Happy” in a file with another word “UnHappy”.  
  
  ii.To delete all lines in a file that contain a pattern “Sugar”.                                (3)  
  
  iii.To append a new line after a pattern “DESC” in a file.  
  
  
  C)   Analyse any two commonly used commands in Subversion Control.  
  (2)
